# Devin Session Board

Devin Session Board archives AI coding sessions, risk notes, review summaries, open questions, delivery receipts, and team handoff evidence.

Website: https://devinsessionboard.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: Devin session archive dashboard
Type: SaaS
Default plan: Team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
